items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 24 at 10:43PM CST until November 25 at 9:00AM CST by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
items.description:
* WHAT...North winds around 20 kt with gusts up to 25 kt and
rough bay waters.

* WHERE...Matagorda Bay and Galveston Bay.

* WHEN...Until 9 AM CST Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
